entities.summary: Anthony Levine Sr., nicknamed "Co-Cap", is an American professional football coach and former player who is the special teams coordinator for the Baltimore Ravens of the National Football League (NFL). He played safety in the NFL for twelve seasons. Levine played college football for the Tennessee State Tigers.
